spec.description: Interactive dashboard for analysing 4000+ job listings — salaries, categories, geography, trends, and more.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', inserted_at) AS time, COUNT(*) AS jobs_posted 
FROM adzuna_jobs 
WHERE inserted_at IS NOT NULL 
  AND category_label IN (${category:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_type, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_type:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_time, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_time:sqlstring}) 
  AND location_display IN (${location:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(company_name, 'Not specified') IN (${company:sqlstring}) 
  AND (salary_min IS NULL OR salary_min >= ${salary_min_filter}::numeric) 
  AND (salary_max IS NULL OR salary_max <= ${salary_max_filter}::numeric) 
  AND $__timeFilter(inserted_at) 
  AND inserted_at >= '2026-07-14'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT COALESCE(contract_type, 'Unknown') AS contract_type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM adzuna_jobs WHERE category_label IN (${category:sqlstring}) AND contract_time IN (${contract_time:sqlstring}) AND location_display IN (${location:sqlstring}) AND company_name IN (${company:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(salary_min, 0) >= ${salary_min_filter}::numeric AND COALESCE(salary_max, 999999999) <= ${salary_max_filter}::numeric GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_jobs FROM adzuna_jobs 
WHERE 
  category_label IN (${category:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(contract_type, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_type:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(contract_time, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_time:sqlstring})
  AND location_display IN (${location:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(company_name, 'Not specified') IN (${company:sqlstring})
  AND (salary_min IS NULL OR salary_min >= ${salary_min_filter}::numeric)
  AND (salary_max IS NULL OR salary_max <= ${salary_max_filter}::numeric);

SELECT COALESCE(category_label, 'Uncategorised') AS category, COUNT(*) AS jobs 
FROM adzuna_jobs 
WHERE category_label IN (${category:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_type, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_type:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_time, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_time:sqlstring}) 
  AND location_display IN (${location:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(company_name, 'Not specified') IN (${company:sqlstring}) 
  AND (salary_min IS NULL OR salary_min >= ${salary_min_filter}::numeric) 
  AND (salary_max IS NULL OR salary_max <= ${salary_max_filter}::numeric) 
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 30;

SELECT company_name AS company, COUNT(*) AS jobs 
FROM adzuna_jobs 
WHERE company_name IS NOT NULL 
  AND category_label IN (${category:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_type, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_type:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_time, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_time:sqlstring}) 
  AND location_display IN (${location:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(company_name, 'Not specified') IN (${company:sqlstring}) 
  AND (salary_min IS NULL OR salary_min >= ${salary_min_filter}::numeric) 
  AND (salary_max IS NULL OR salary_max <= ${salary_max_filter}::numeric) 
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(salary_min)) AS avg_min_salary 
FROM adzuna_jobs 
WHERE salary_min IS NOT NULL AND salary_min > 0 
  AND category_label IN (${category:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_type, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_type:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_time, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_time:sqlstring}) 
  AND location_display IN (${location:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(company_name, 'Not specified') IN (${company:sqlstring}) 
  AND salary_min >= ${salary_min_filter}::numeric 
  AND salary_max <= ${salary_max_filter}::numeric;

SELECT salary_min 
FROM adzuna_jobs 
WHERE salary_min IS NOT NULL AND salary_min > 0 AND salary_min < 300000 
  AND category_label IN (${category:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_type, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_type:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_time, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_time:sqlstring}) 
  AND location_display IN (${location:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(company_name, 'Not specified') IN (${company:sqlstring}) 
  AND salary_min >= ${salary_min_filter}::numeric 
  AND salary_max <= ${salary_max_filter}::numeric;

SELECT category_label AS category, ROUND(AVG(salary_min)) AS avg_min_salary, ROUND(AVG(salary_max)) AS avg_max_salary 
FROM adzuna_jobs 
WHERE salary_min IS NOT NULL AND salary_min > 0 
  AND salary_max IS NOT NULL AND salary_max > 0 
  AND category_label IS NOT NULL 
  AND category_label IN (${category:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_type, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_type:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_time, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_time:sqlstring}) 
  AND location_display IN (${location:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(company_name, 'Not specified') IN (${company:sqlstring}) 
  AND salary_min >= ${salary_min_filter}::numeric 
  AND salary_max <= ${salary_max_filter}::numeric 
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_max_salary DESC LIMIT 15;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(salary_max)) AS avg_max_salary 
FROM adzuna_jobs 
WHERE salary_max IS NOT NULL AND salary_max > 0 
  AND category_label IN (${category:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_type, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_type:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_time, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_time:sqlstring}) 
  AND location_display IN (${location:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(company_name, 'Not specified') IN (${company:sqlstring}) 
  AND salary_min >= ${salary_min_filter}::numeric 
  AND salary_max <= ${salary_max_filter}::numeric;

SELECT ROUND(latitude::numeric, 2) AS latitude, ROUND(longitude::numeric, 2) AS longitude, COUNT(*) AS job_count, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(salary_min, 0))) AS avg_salary 
FROM adzuna_jobs 
WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL AND latitude != 0 AND longitude != 0 
  AND category_label IN (${category:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_type, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_type:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_time, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_time:sqlstring}) 
  AND location_display IN (${location:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(company_name, 'Not specified') IN (${company:sqlstring}) 
  AND (salary_min IS NULL OR salary_min >= ${salary_min_filter}::numeric) 
  AND (salary_max IS NULL OR salary_max <= ${salary_max_filter}::numeric) 
GROUP BY 1, 2;

SELECT location_display AS location, COUNT(*) AS jobs 
FROM adzuna_jobs 
WHERE location_display IS NOT NULL 
  AND category_label IN (${category:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_type, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_type:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_time, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_time:sqlstring}) 
  AND location_display IN (${location:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(company_name, 'Not specified') IN (${company:sqlstring}) 
  AND (salary_min IS NULL OR salary_min >= ${salary_min_filter}::numeric) 
  AND (salary_max IS NULL OR salary_max <= ${salary_max_filter}::numeric) 
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT company_name) AS unique_companies 
FROM adzuna_jobs 
WHERE company_name IS NOT NULL 
  AND category_label IN (${category:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_type, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_type:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_time, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_time:sqlstring}) 
  AND location_display IN (${location:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(company_name, 'Not specified') IN (${company:sqlstring}) 
  AND (salary_min IS NULL OR salary_min >= ${salary_min_filter}::numeric) 
  AND (salary_max IS NULL OR salary_max <= ${salary_max_filter}::numeric);

SELECT CASE WHEN salary_is_predicted = true THEN 'Predicted' ELSE 'Actual' END AS salary_type, COUNT(*) AS count 
FROM adzuna_jobs 
WHERE category_label IN (${category:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_type, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_type:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_time, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_time:sqlstring}) 
  AND location_display IN (${location:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(company_name, 'Not specified') IN (${company:sqlstring}) 
GROUP BY 1;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', inserted_at) AS time, category_label AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value 
FROM adzuna_jobs 
WHERE inserted_at IS NOT NULL 
  AND category_label IS NOT NULL 
  AND category_label IN (${category:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_type, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_type:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_time, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_time:sqlstring}) 
  AND location_display IN (${location:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(company_name, 'Not specified') IN (${company:sqlstring}) 
  AND (salary_min IS NULL OR salary_min >= ${salary_min_filter}::numeric) 
  AND (salary_max IS NULL OR salary_max <= ${salary_max_filter}::numeric) 
  AND $__timeFilter(inserted_at) 
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT category_label) AS categories 
FROM adzuna_jobs 
WHERE category_label IS NOT NULL 
  AND category_label IN (${category:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_type, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_type:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_time, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_time:sqlstring}) 
  AND location_display IN (${location:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(company_name, 'Not specified') IN (${company:sqlstring});

SELECT title, company_name, category_label, salary_min, salary_max, CASE WHEN salary_is_predicted THEN 'Predicted' ELSE 'Actual' END AS salary_type, contract_type, contract_time, location_display, location_area, inserted_at, redirect_url FROM adzuna_jobs WHERE category_label IN (${category:sqlstring}) AND contract_type IN (${contract_type:sqlstring}) AND contract_time IN (${contract_time:sqlstring}) AND location_display IN (${location:sqlstring}) AND company_name IN (${company:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(salary_min, 0) >= ${salary_min_filter}::numeric AND COALESCE(salary_max, 999999999) <= ${salary_max_filter}::numeric ORDER BY inserted_at DESC LIMIT 500;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN salary_is_predicted = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS pct_predicted 
FROM adzuna_jobs 
WHERE category_label IN (${category:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_type, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_type:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(contract_time, 'Not specified') IN (${contract_time:sqlstring}) 
  AND location_display IN (${location:sqlstring}) 
  AND COALESCE(company_name, 'Not specified') IN (${company:sqlstring});
